reviews.text:
Fantastic service
Always available to help
Attentive and knowledgeable
Friendliness and professionalism
Always super attentive and helpful. They answer questions and give advice. My favorite store for my pets 🙂 …

The best order I've ever placed. It was an urgent order, so I emailed them to find out approximately how long it would take to arrive, and they told me it would arrive in 24 to 48 hours, although now with the holidays it could be delayed, but I ordered anyway. They were super quick to respond and ship. I ordered around 4 pm and received an email at 10 am saying it had already arrived.

I will order here again.
For those looking for supplies for exotic animals, they have everything. I, at least, always find what I need!
They are amazing in every aspect. I've always bought online and the orders arrive quickly and are impeccably packaged!
Excellent service and a good variety of products; I like to buy hamster treats there.
All good

Amazing place, full of quality products for animals at an affordable price. I loved the space, with very attentive staff. With good and wide variety of products for rabbits, which are so difficult to find elsewhere. I recommend it, it will be my new go-to place for my pets ❤️
Good service in a unique store for unique animals.

Super lovely store, 5-star staff.
It's always better to go to a store and feel that people really enjoy what they're doing and care about the well-being of our animals. I'll be buying everything for my rabbit here from now on!
A special corner, full of variety and amazing things for our best friends. Excellent service with products to match!
Products, quality, and service 5 stars! I always buy here.

The store is beautiful and full of new things! We have guinea pigs and you can find several healthy food options, special hays in different cuts, snacks, interactive toys, and treats for their cage. I recommend a leisurely visit ;) Thank you ;)

Best store for exotic animals!!! Amazing products, affordable prices, caring staff, and fast delivery! This is my second order and I'm always surprised by the products; I've never seen such good hay! In addition, the employee Tiago is a worker like no other these days – very helpful, caring... Incredible! I highly recommend it!!!
Excellent

This store is excellent, order processing is fast, but above all, there's professionalism and great friendliness from the people who work there, and that should be valued more than anything. I highly recommend it! 🤩 …

Excellent shop for exotic animals. The best in Portugal, without a doubt. I don't know what Mel (my rabbit Belier) and I would do without your products! Thank you so much for all the care you put into your orders.
Kindness and knowledge in the advice they give.
Beautiful pet store with specially products and craft items
I loved the service provided, the order arrived super fast, everything was nicely packaged, and the prices are quite competitive. They even offered a little gift :) They've gained a customer.
